title.en: An Act Transferring the Barrios of Kisolon and San Vicente of the Municipality of Impasugong and the Sitio of Damay of the Municipality of Manolo Fortich to the Municipality of Sumilao in the Province of Bukidnon
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Barrios of Kisolon and San Vicente of the Municipality of Impasugong and the Sitio of Damay of the Municipality of Manolo Fortich to the Municipality of Sumilao in the Province of Bukidnon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5924_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Kisolon and San Vicente of the Municipality of Impasugong and the sitio of Damay of the Municipality of Manolo Fortich, Province of Bukidnon, including all of the territories bounded by the Kulaman, Tagoloan and Alalum rivers in the west, north and east, respectively, and on the south by the present boundary of the Municipality of Sumilao, are hereby segregated from their respective municipalities and transferred to the Municipality of Sumilao, Province of Bukidnon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 21, 1969.
